name: imposition-toolkit
description: Client-side PDF imposition & pre-press toolkit — 85 print-production tools, 156 ready-made industry templates, and 6 chained workflows (booklets, n-up, cards, labels, folding, large-format, tickets, marks, dielines, cut-contour spot toolpaths, white/varnish spot layers, braille, QR/Code128/DataMatrix/EAN-13 barcodes, file backdrops, true-shape sticker nesting, collating + gathering + OMR + lay + fold bindery marks, CSV data-merge + QR, resize, registration, insert/mix/nudge/repair) that run entirely in the browser via pdf-lib. Framework-agnostic engine + optional React 19 UI with a dark theme.

scripts.build: esbuild src/impose.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/impose.mjs && tsc src/pdfjs-worker-url.d.ts src/impose.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2020 --outDir dist
